name: seis-workflow-linter
description: Read-only validation of SEIS workflow trigger, condition, approval, action, retry, and audit stages.

interface.shortDescription: Check workflow safety stages before execution.
interface.longDescription: A deterministic local SEIS automation-governance plugin that validates JSON workflow definitions for triggers, conditions, approvals, actions, retries, and audit stages without running or rewriting workflows.
defaultPrompt: Find missing approval and audit stages.
Check workflow retries without running it.
